item_fields.context_label: string|null; deal or notification subject name
item_fields.open_url: string|null; relative destination or source notification deep link
item_fields.merged_source_ids: UUID[]; canonical source IDs collapsed into this card
item_fields.action_id: UUID|null; next_action or capture_post_call_action ID for complete-one-action
item_fields.action_version: integer|null; canonical action version, sent as complete-one-action base_version
item_fields.deal_id: UUID|null; owning deal for completion readback, null for non-deal work
item_fields.auto_settled: boolean; canonical resolution placed this item in Settled without a disposition write

truncated: boolean; the item limit or 10000-notification scan bound was exceeded
ordering: Unfinished first, newest activity first, item ID as tie breaker
completion: Only task items have action_id and action_version. Complete the representative action only; merged_source_ids are display provenance, never a bulk completion instruction. No task reopening verb is added.
settlement: Canonical done tasks and sent replies settle automatically. A future snooze and explicit un-settle take precedence. Notification completion and call-processing completion do not prove all underlying work resolved. Fact-review and tour-feedback sources are not included. Versions remain the existing disposition-command authority; retry exact requests and hydrate receipts through this read.
